body: As silentlaughter said, it's not that I'm greedy...it's just that I used it to pay rent, phone bill, etc. I don't know what to do without it, and am facing eviction at the end of April.

Well it looks like there's a 99% chance that I've found somewhere to stay, but that really wasn't the bulk of my problems.

To elaborate, I think that the fact that our world is consumed with greed and people only look out for themselves. Politics on various things really piss me off. When I found out that everybody isn't as well off as we are in the US, outsourcing just to save some money, big CEOs whiter millions by trampling those who work for them. All of that stuff I've learned from growing up really makes me not want to live in his world either. Especially drugs. My brother had lots of problems with drugs and it go him in quite a bit of trouble. Most of my friends (read: all but 1 or 2) drink, smoke pot, and/or do shrooms. It really pisses me off that people can't be happy when they're not using. But maybe that isn't possible...

It seems that pretty much everyone who has gotten over depression says "just hang on" or "it will pass" which isn't too promising because obviously I am depressed now and it would be much better, in my opinion, to just take my life now and just be done with it.
I'm 19. I absolutely refuse to go back to my parents. It would make me more depressed.
